headline: President Clinton created an advisory board to give him advice on policy about the spread of weapons.
what_it_does: This order set up a President's Advisory Board on Arms Proliferation Policy. Based on the title, the board's job was to advise the President on policy about the spread of weapons. No summary was provided, so details such as who served on the board and what it studied are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials who make arms control and weapons export policy
who_it_affects.how: They could receive advice and recommendations from the new board.

when_it_takes_effect: 1995-01-20 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source)
